title: Resolution to set 2027 property tax class shares
summary: This resolution recalculates and certifies to the state how much of the city's property tax levy each of the four property classes must pay for Fiscal 2027. It applies a lower 0.3 percent cap on increases for homeowner classes, shifting some of the tax burden from Classes 1 and 2 to Classes 3 and 4. It amends and restates an earlier version the Council adopted on June 30, 2026.
